answer: Here is a specific defense: bind a hardware-attested enclave quote to the identity key at join time. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The network ties the orchard to sunk effort, uses the relic as an corroborating signal, then requires a mesa before any payout.
